data.one_liner: Encrypt shared preferences on Android and UserDefaults on iOS using AES-CBC-128.
data.what_it_does: A package to store and retrieve encrypted key-value data using shared preferences on Android and UserDefaults on iOS. It supports multiple data types including String, int, bool, double, map, and List<String>, using the AES-CBC-128 algorithm.
use_when: You need to store sensitive key-value pairs securely on device
You want a familiar shared preferences interface with optional encryption
avoid_when: You require complex relational queries (use a database instead)
You need secure storage specifically relying exclusively on platform native secure storage without shared preferences wrappers
strengths: Encrypts both keys and values using AES-CBC-128
Supports multiple data types including maps and lists
Allows bypassing encryption per entry via a boolean parameter
weaknesses: Relies on older or mixed underlying dependencies like package_info
Limited documentation beyond basic read/write examples

alternatives.name: flutter_secure_storage
alternatives.why_pick_it: It is a more widely used and dedicated solution for secure storage on mobile platforms.

alternatives.name: shared_preferences
alternatives.why_pick_it: Use this if you do not need encryption and only require standard key-value storage.
